page.notes: Greek words "θεόπνευστος" (Epistola Iudæ) and "δευτερώσεις" (Hebræorum) are read from a small, slightly blurred scan and are uncertain. "scripturatum" in the entry "verâ scripturatum cognitionem" is doubtful; the scan may print "scripturarum".
